from qiskit.algorithms import QuantumApproximateOptimizationAlgorithm as QAOA

def create_graph(vertices: List[int], edges: List[List[int]]):

    G.add_weighted_edges_from(edges)

    partition1, partition2 = list(partitions[0]), list(set(G.nodes) - set(partition1))
    return partition1, partition2

def get_cut_value(G, partition1, partition2):
    cut_value = sum(G[u][v] for u, v in zip(partition1, partition2))
    return cut_value

def qaoa_energy(qc: QuantumCircuit, G, partition1: List[int], partition2: List[int]):
    n = len(G.nodes)
    beta_term = qc. PauliX(n - 1) @ qc. PauliZ(n - 1)
    gamma_term = qc. PauliZ(n)

                qc.append(qc.CZ(u, v), [(2 * edge_weight, 1), (2 * edge_weight, 2)])
